{{Vanilla|Hopper}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''hopper''' is a block that moves items. [[Matcha Flavoured]] makes it much cheaper.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
Five iron ingots and a chest or barrel make 4 hoppers, and five [[Steel Alloy|steel alloy]] make 8. The vanilla recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/hopper_from_iron.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
The [[Engineer]] sells 32 hoppers for 1 [[obol]] at the journeyman level.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/armorer/3/hopper.json}}</ref>
